findings.message: Literal prohibition conflicts with the required six actual keyless preflight commands, whose Go tests necessarily execute native binaries. State instead that these modes never acquire a selected credential, create a paid canonical intent or execute any selected paid job; check still must execute the fixed six keyless commands and persist their actual numeric exits. This prevents a future implementation from satisfying the phrase by silently omitting real preflight execution.
